newsitem.title: USA: U.S. has no objection to Westinghouse unit sale.
newsitem.headline: U.S. has no objection to Westinghouse unit sale.

text.p: Federal anti-trust agencies have decided against challenging Western Resources Inc if it purchases Westinghouse Electric Co's security system business, a government spokesman said Thursday.
The announcement by the Federal Trade Commission means that no government action would be taken by the FTC or the anti-trust division of the Justice Department to halt the sale.
A spokeswoman for Western Resources, based in Topeka, Kan., declined comment, as did a spokeswoman for Westinghouse Electric in Pittsburgh.
But someone familiar with the negotiations said there was no final agreement on the sale.
Westinghouse has been seeking to sell its security systems unit, which is part of its Communications and Information unit.
Western operates regulated utilities and other unregulated business, including a security division.
